_note: The Preparatory-stage record is SOURCED against the actual NCF-SE 2023 document (official PDF: ncert.nic.in/pdf/NCFSE-2023-August_2023.pdf, Part C p.268-293, Mathematics Learning Standards). ncf_curricular_goal_id/ncf_competency_code carry NCF's own real codes (CG-1 / C-1.2 for Preparatory, CG-1 / C-1.4 for Middle Stage — different competency numbers under the same-named CG-1 because each Stage restates its own CG-1). statement_en/statement_te are Tut-P's own paraphrase of each competency's meaning, not a verbatim quote of the document — per copyright policy. Note the Middle Stage statement was corrected from an earlier placeholder ('converts fractions to decimals') to what C-1.4 actually says (understanding number sets generally and placing them on a number line) — decimal notation specifically isn't named in this competency; the earlier text was an assumption, not a finding.

records.subject: mathematics
records.statement_en: Represents and compares everyday fractions (such as half, quarter) as parts of a whole, as points on a number line, and as the result of dividing a whole number by another
records.statement_te: రోజువారీ జీవితంలో వాడే భిన్నాలను (సగం, పావు వంతు వంటివి) — ఒక పూర్తి వస్తువులో భాగంగా, సంఖ్యారేఖపై బిందువుగా, మరియు ఒక సంఖ్యను మరో సంఖ్యతో భాగించిన ఫలితంగా — సూచించడం మరియు పోల్చడం

source.document: National Curriculum Framework for School Education 2023 (NCF-SE 2023), Part C: Mathematics Learning Standards, Preparatory Stage, Curricular Goal CG-1, Competency C-1.2
source.page_or_section: Part C, approx. p.268-270 (Mathematics Learning Standards table)

records.subject: mathematics
records.statement_en: Explores number sets — whole numbers, fractions, integers, rational and real numbers — understands their properties, and places them on a number line
records.statement_te: సంఖ్యా సమూహాలను (సహజ సంఖ్యలు, భిన్నాలు, పూర్ణ సంఖ్యలు, పరిమేయ సంఖ్యలు, వాస్తవ సంఖ్యలు) పరిశోధించడం, వాటి లక్షణాలను అర్థం చేసుకోవడం, మరియు వాటిని సంఖ్యారేఖపై గుర్తించడం

source.document: NCF-SE 2023, Part C: Mathematics Learning Standards, Middle Stage, Curricular Goal CG-1 ('Understands numbers and patterns'), Competency C-1.4
